tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dzam+bha la dmar po'i srog sgrub kyi gdams pa rje sa chen gyi man ngag bzhugs so// gser chos// ༄༅// bla ma bde mchog 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig rang ngam gzhan la phan bde 'byung ba'i phyir du dzam+bha la dmar po'i srog sgrub nyams su len par 'dod pas/ rten bca' ba dang*/ bsnyen pa bya ba dang*/ las la bskul ba'i cho ga dang gsum gyis rtogs par bya'o// dang po ni/ mi'i pags pa sor brgyad pa'i khug ma'i nang du rin po che lnga/ 'bru lnga/ sman sna lnga/ dzam+bha la yab yum gyi sku

dzam+bha la yab yum gyi bri gzhi dar ras dmar po la dri bzang phye mas byugs la gser gyis bri ba'am shog bu rgya tshos kyis bsgyur ba la gser bcad kyis bri'o// sngags dang bcas pa skar ma rgyal gyi nyin par bri la/ sku'i rgyab tu sngags tshar gsum tsam la ji ltar 'dod pa'i spel tshig dang rten 'brel snying po gser gyis bri/ de ma grub na gi wang gis bri'o// rab tu gnas par byas nas/ khug mar rdzas dang lhan cig tu gzhug de tshon skud sna lngas bcings te mchan khung g.yon du gdags par mis ma mthong bar bya ba man ngag go/ bya ba ni gsang ba'i rten bca' ba'i man ngag go /gnyis pa bsnyen sgrub nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ dang po skar ma rgyal lta bu la bla ma las rjes su gnang ba dang*/ lung blangs nas nyams su len pa'am/ phyis skar ma rgyal lta bu nas nyams su len par bya'o// de la thog mar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du song nas/ rang bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa yab yum mam/ yi dam gang rung ltar bskyed/ bzlas pa byas la/ mdun du pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba bh+rūm̐ las gser gyi bum pa ni rin po che'i chun 'phyang ba kha g.yas g.yon du blta ba/ gnyis kyi steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du dzam̐ dang bam̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las dzam+bha la yab yum du bskyed/ de'ang yab sku mdog dmar po zhag gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum pa dbu'i steng na nor bu rin po che 'od 'tsher bas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po bsnams shing*/ g.yon pa ne'u le rin po ches gang zhing skyugs pa bsnams pas yum la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa can du bskyed do// de'i pang du yum rgyas byed ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/

g.yas na nor bu rin po che 'od 'bar ba bsnams pas sgrub pa po la rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams nas yab la stob pa'i tshul du 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang bde ba chen po la dgyes pa'i tshul gyis khro zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ thabs kyis sbyor zhing yum gyis skul ba'i nyams bskyed pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bde ba chen po'i rnam pa can yab yum gyi skur bsgom par bya'o// de gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ dbang bskur te rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyas btab pa la/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa'ang dbul bar bya'o// bstod pa ni/ rjes chags dpa' bo mchog tu bde ba'i rang bzhin can// zag pa gnyis bral mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dpa' mo che// gnyis med rnam rol dgos 'dod kun 'byung mchog gi lha// mgon po khyod la mngon par 'dud do mngon phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod par bya'o// de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi mthar yi dam gyi sngags dang*/ dbus su yi dam gyi sa bon dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i dzam+bha la yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma la yi dam gyi sa bon bsam/ yi dam gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun gyi dzam+bha la yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du dzam̐ dang bam̐ gyi sngags kyis bskor ba/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum pa'i snod bcud kyi nus mthu ji snyed dang*/ ji ltar 'dod pa rnams bsdus nas bdag la dngos grub stsal bar mos la bzlas pa bya'o// thun gyi mjug tu rlung 'byung 'jug gnas pa dang bstun nas spro bsdu'i dmigs pa bya ba

rlung kha sbyor gyi las sbyor lag len bzhin ni dpogs chog go /bzlas sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya dha naṃ me dhi hrīḥ ḍā ki nī dzam+bha la sam+bha ra swā hā/ 'di brgya'am stong la sogs pa nyin re bzhin ma chag par bzla bar bya'o// de nas skyo bar gyur na/ mchod bstod bya/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma dku bag can gang 'byor byin gyis brlabs la/ sngags la a kā ro btags la dbul lo// yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang yang spros bral mi dmigs pa'i ngang du gzhag dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// 'di ni bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i man ngag go /thun mtshams su chu sbyin brgya rtsa'am ci nus kyang dbul lo// de ltar bsgrubs pas grub pa'i rtags 'di rnams 'byung ste/ skyes pa dang bud med mang pos phyag dang bskor ba byed pa dang*/ 'bras chan ster ba dang*/ gdan bting ba dang*/ rin po che'i ri la 'dzegs pa dang*/ gter rnyed pa dang*/ nyi ma shar ba dang*/ nam langs pa dang*/ mi mang por chos ston pa dang*/ gos dmar po khyad par can gon pa/ rnga dang dung dang ḍā ma ru la sogs pa rol mo sna tshogs pa 'khrol ba rmi lam du 'byung ngo*// gsum pa las la bskul ba'i cho ga ni/ rtags gong du bshad pa bzhin byung ba'i rjes la dzam+bha la yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum la khro bo dang khro mo kha dog dmar po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa spros/ rang la nye bar mkho ba'i mi nor zas gos la sogs pa gang 'dod pa dngos grub tu khyer byung bar mos nas/ sngags dang dmigs pa brtan por bzung bas gang 'dod 'grub/ des kyang ma grub na/ go ldog gi man ngag ni/ rang dzam+bha la yab yum du bsgom/ mdun gyi yi dam gyi thugs kar dzam+bha la yab yum bsgoms la sngags kyi 'od zer gyis gnad la gzir bas gang 'dod pa 'gugs pa'i dngos grub bkug par mos la bzlas pa bya/

'di yang dpogs pa'i cho ga bzhin rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la sbyar bas 'di ni shin tu zab pa'i gnad yin pas 'di tsam gyis las ma lus pa 'grub nges pa yin no// chog go /las bskul gyi cho ga rdzogs par bstan zin to// de ltar bsgrubs pa la brten nas rab mchog gi dngos grub thob/ 'bring 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por phun sum tshogs pa thob pa dang*/ 'gyur/ tha ma yang zas nor la dbang thogs pa med par 'gyur ro// man ngag gi rim pa'i gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa ma sbas par yi ger bris pa sa ma pa tha/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i gsung rab bo// ༈ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa nas rim par brgyud de/ paṇ+ḍi ta ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi lo tsā ba/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ bla ma sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ yar sgom se bo khu dbon/ rgya tsha lung mang po ngag gi dbang phyug mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ bdag yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan no// 'di'i lung blang ba'i skabs 'dir skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i tshe slob dpon yi dam bde mchog gam gang rung gyi bskyed bzlas bya/ mdun du lag len la sa dmar gyi stegs bu gru bzhi la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng du mañdzi'i sting maṇ+ḍa lar sa dmar ram sin+dhu ra byugs la chos 'byung gi dbus su dzam̐ bam̐ re la sngags g.yas skor du bri/ pad+ma dmar po'i maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung sngags dang sa bon can gyi drung du mchod pa gtor ma ci 'byor pa bsham/ maṇ+ḍal bskyed bzlas bya/ mchod gtor dbul/ slob mas gsol gdab dang sems bskyed khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ gur gyi rgyun bshags/ sngon du 'gro bas slob ma nor lha yab yum du bskyed la/

maṇ+ḍal gyi lha sku gsung thugs/ bstim pas byin gyis brlab cing spyi bor rdo rje bzhag cing tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras/ brtan par bya'o// rdul tshon blangs nas 'bru gsum brjod/ slob ma'i dpral bar lan gsum byug pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka nas yi dam gyi lha'i sngags kyis thog drangs pa'i sngags 'phros slob ma'i snying gar dzam̐ bam̐ gyi mkhar 'khor bar bsams la bzlas pa'i lung sbyin/ lan gsum gyi dang pos dam tshig pa/ gnyis pas ye shes pa/ gsum pas byin gyis brlabs par mos pa yin no// dam bca' khas len par 'dod na dam bca'i lung yang dbog go /rdzas bsdu tsā ru'i bza' ba la sogs pa longs spyad par bya'o// lung blang ba'i man ngag bla ma'i gsung bzhin sa skyar sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /gong dkar rdo rje gdan pas mdzad/ 'di'i sku'i rjes su gnang ba 'di la/ mdun bskyed kyi dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po byung*/ slob ma dzaṃ dmar du gsal ba'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po la thim/ lus kyi dri ma dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po byung*/ slob ma dzam̐ dmar du gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po la thim/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po byung*/ slob ma dzam̐ dmar du gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ sngon po la thim/ yid kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ces brjod/ gzhan dkyus bzhin no// sarba dā ka l+yā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /rje btsun sa skya pa'i gser chos dzam+bha la dmar po'i srog sgrub kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang go bde bklag chog bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ mi zad gter gyi bum pa zung gi khrir// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan brjid mdzes sku// dran pas 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs yid bzhin nor// lha mchog gang des mchog gi dngos grub stsol// 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdams pa dzaṃ dmar srog sgrub tu grags pa'i rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul la/

skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i dus su stegs bu la rdul mtshon dmar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i steng*/ mañdzi'i steng du maṇ+ḍa lar sin+dhu ra byugs pa la/ chos 'byung gi dbus su dzam̐ bam̐/ de'i mdun nas g.yas skor du sngags kyis bskor ba bris pa gzhag mdun du gtor ma nor bu mig gsum pa'i dbyibs can mar gyi rgyan ci mdzes kyis spras shing 'bri mog gis kha bsgyur ba dar dmar po'i cod pan dang*/ zas sna'i bye brag ci 'byor bsham/ de dag gi mtha' skor ram mdun gang bder chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod zhal zas spyan gzigs dmar po dang bcas pa bsham zhing*/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril me tog gi snod sogs mthong brgyud kyi phyag len ltar bkod pas mdzes par bya/ de nas rang nyid stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya zhing*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ bde kye gang rung gi bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar so so'i gzhung bzhin bya/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du a las zla ba bh+rūm̐ las gter gyi bum pa rin po ches gang ba kha g.yas g.yon du blta ba gnyis kyi steng du ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du dzam̐ dang bam̐ las nor bu dzam̐ dang bam̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa dzam+bha la sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa dbu'i steng na nor bu rin po che 'od 'tsher bas brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pas nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po bsnams zhing*/ g.yon pa ne'u le rin po ches gang zhing skyugs pa bsnams pas yum la 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/

de'i pang na yum rgyas byed ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas na nor bu rin po che 'od 'bar ba bsnams pas sgrub pa po la nor bu rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ g.yon bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la stob pa'i tshul du 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang bde ba chen po skyed pa'i tshul gyis khro zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ thabs kyis sbyor zhing yum gyis skul ba'i nyams bskyed pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bde ba chen po'i rnam pa can gyi skur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa dzam+bha la yab yum la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chu spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ mchod pa bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i/ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes btags pas nang mchod dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ rjes chags dpa' bo mchog tu bde ba'i rang bzhin can// zag pa gnyis bral mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dpa' mo che// gnyis med rnam rol dgos 'dod kun 'byung mchog gi lha// mgon po khyod la mngon par 'dud do mngon phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod par bya'o// gtor ma chu chang gis bran/

bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la yi dam gyi sngags dang dbus su yi dam gyi sa bon/ dzam+bha la yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma la yi dam gyi sa bon bsam/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros dzam+bha la yab yum gyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du dzam̐ dang bam̐ gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud kyi nus mthu thams cad dang*/ ci 'dod dbang du bsdus nas bdag la dngos grub stsol bar bsams nas/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya dha naṃ me dhi hrīḥḍā ki nī dzam+bha la saṃ bha ra swā hā/ zhes pas sngags ci nus bzla'o// de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ slob dpon gyis chos bshad rgyas bsdus ci rigs byas nas/ 'dir gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la gdams pa rgya mtsho tsam phyag tu babs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa dzam+bha la dmar po'i srog sgrub tu grags pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams legs par grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa la slob dpon yi dam gyi lha'i ngo bor gyur pa la gnod sbyin yab yum gyi rjes su gnang ba zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ zhes 'bul du gzhug de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gter// gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol// zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab/

rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa mngon sum lta bur mos nas yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags bya/ dngos gzhir sku'i rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la 'khor lo bde mchog dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib gdos bcas sha khrag gi bsdus pa'i phung khams bskyed mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po zhes pa nas/ rnam pa can gyi skur gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal lam ste yod par mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed la phog pas mdun gyi dzam+bha la'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ khyed rang rnams dzam̐ dmar du gsal ba'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po la thim/ lus kyi dri ma dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po las 'od zer dmar po byung*/ slob ma dzam̐ dmar du gsal ba'i mgrin pa'i āḥdamar po la thim/ ngag gi dri ma dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po byung*/ slob ma dzam̐ dmar du gsal ba'i snying ga'i hūm̐ sngon po la thim/ yid kyi dri ma dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob nas dzam+bha la yab yum gyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ rtsa sngags dang dril gsil bya/ de ltar ye shes pa brtan par bya ba'i slad du spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod byas pa la/

mgo bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas/ dzam̐ bam̐ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal nas slob dpon gyis blangs te khyed rang rnams kyi dpral mgrin snying gsum du byugs nas byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gnas gsum du byug bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed la phog pas yab yum gyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng mar me'i phreng ba lta bu 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar dzam̐ dang bam̐ gyi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya dha naṃ me dhi naṃ me dhi hrīḥḍā ki nī dzam+bha la saṃ bha ra swā hā/ zhes lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brten par byas pa'i mos pa byas nas/ slob dpon la drin lan du me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la 'go bar mdzod// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs gsum/ dam bca' ba'i slad du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dzam+bha la yab yum yi dam gyi lhar gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyis dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du 'phags pa dzam+bha la yab yum yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ tsā ru'i bza' ba dpon slob thams cad kyis longs spyad/ mdun bskyed mchod pa kha gso/ mchod bstod bzod gsol bsngo smon bkra shis spyi dang mthun par bya'o// de ltar nor lha'i gtso bo dzam+bha la// dmar po'i srog gi sgrub pa'i mngon rtogs dang*// rjes gnang bya tshul go bde bklag chog tu// bkod 'dis 'gro ba'i dbul phongs zhi gyur cig

/ces dpal ldan sa skya pa'i khyad par gyi gdams pa dzaṃ dmar srog sgrub tu grags pa'i mngon rtogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa go bde bklag chog tu bkod pa 'di'ang sa skya pa chen po'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don 'khrul med dang*/ rje bla ma'i phyag len ji lta bar rang gi dran pa gso phyir bka' 'bangs kyi tha shal lhun grub kyis bris pa'o// ༈ /dzaṃ dmar srog sgrub kyi brgyud 'debs 'dod rgu'i mchog stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ye shes mkha' 'gro grub chen bir+wa pa// nag po ḍa ma ru pa gnyis spangs zhabs// ga ya dha ra 'brog mi gsal ba'i snying*// sgyi chu 'khon ston rnams la gsol ba 'debs// sa chen rtse mo grags pa yar sgom che// ston tshul chos kyi dbang phyug yon tan khri// seng bzang seng ge rgyal mtshan bsod nams dar// rgyal mtshan 'od zer rnams la gsol ba 'debs// kun bzang rol pa rin chen chos kyi rgyal// rdo rje rgyal mtshan shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal// dkon mchog dpal ldan nam mkha' dpal bzang po// mchog legs rdo rje rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bstan 'dzin bzang po mkhyen rab byams pa'i zhabs// rmor chen rje dang 'jam mgon gnas gsar ba// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dpal// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// gsang ba'i rten dang bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyis// rmugs 'dzin dbang po dgyes pa'i dge mtshan mthus// 'dod rgu'i dpal dang 'khor los sgyur ba'i stobs// dbang bcu'i ye shes brnyes par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang dran pas srid zhi'i dpal ster rdo rje 'chang byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa sid+dhi rastu/ sarba dā shrī yo bha ba tu// ༈ /gnyan lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i dzam+bha la sum sgril gyi man ngag bzhugs so// ār+ya dzam+bha la na mo/ rnal 'byor pa phrin las kyi 'gro don chung na 'di ltar bya ste/

dzam+bha la sku mdog dmar po phyag g.yas na rin chen 'bar ba bsnams pa/ g.yon ne'u le'i rkyal pa bsnams pa/ de'i 'og tu tshogs bdag dmar po gcer bu rgyan med pa/ g.yas lcags kyu bsnams pa/ de'i 'og tu a pa rā dzi ta sku mdog dmar po sku la dar dmar gsol ba/ g.yas lcags kyu bsnams pa/ g.yon zhags pa bsnams pa'o// de'i 'og tu the'u rang spun gsum/ g.yas rin po che 'bar ba/ g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ de gsum gyi snying gar tri raṃ bri'o// maṇ+ḍal rkang khru gang legs par byas la/ de'i steng du nas bre gang la tsakli btsugs la gzhag gtor ma zlum po gcig gtar gzung*/ de nas sngags bzla bar bya'o// oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya hrīṃ dza dzaḥ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti hrīṃ dza dzaḥ a pa rā dzi ta hrīṃ dza dzaḥ tri du tri du/ yak+ṣi tri du/ ga ṇa pa ti tri du/ bdag la yon tan stsol mkhan myur du thong*/ snyan pa dang grags pa sgrogs shig wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes bdun bzla'o// zhag lnga song nas tsakli dar dmar pos gtums nas phreng ba'i mdud 'dzin la gdags/ nang re bzhin mi tshig ma 'dres pa la/ rang khro bor gsal ba'i mtheb 'og tu mnan la/ sngags smon tshig dang bcas pa tshar bdun bzlas te/ phreng ba phyogs bzhir brdabs te/ khug ma sa la rdeb pa'i rnam 'gyur bya'o// zhag gcig rkang pa g.yas pa'i mthe bo'i 'og tu mnan/ de nas rab gnas bya/ phreng ba'i mdud 'dzin la gdag go /'gom yug ma song bar gal che/ sngags 'di dus bzhir rab brgya rtsa bzla/ 'bring nyi shu rtsa gcig tha ma bdun bzla'o// des gdul bya dang*/ g.yeng ba che/ grags pa yong*/ g.yeng ba che na sngags phreng 'phro gcad do// bsod nams cher 'bar bar 'dod na dus bzhir bzlas pa bya'o// tsakli bri dus mgo phyogs gcig tu steng 'og yong bar bya/ bar bar du sngags tshang bar bri/ mdud 'dzin tsakli mgo sprod pa yin/ gnyan lo tsā ba'i lag 'gul dzam+bha la sum sgril zhes bya ba rdzogs so// bsnyen sgrub mi dgos las sbyor kho nas chog go

/'di'i brgyud pa gnyan lo nas gnang kha'u pa/ sa chen man 'dra'o// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
